floor_over_configured_interruptions.definition: Floor(H) = min over configured interruptions of U(H, i)

terminology.conditional_association_vs_counterfactua: Bucket deltas are observational associations. Extender replacement analysis is the interventional counterpart.
terminology.floor: Floor(H) = min_i U(H, i) over the configured/evaluated interruption set only.
terminology.playable_at_threshold: Playable_T(H, I) := U(H, I) >= T with T explicit/configurable.
terminology.principle: Every analytical term maps to an observable quantity, explicit mathematical function, or configurable predicate.
terminology.solver_outcomes: U(H, I) and category scores from search.
